name: Indiana FFA membership through your school ag class
what_you_do: Join FFA through your school's agriculture class. FFA is the student group tied to agricultural education in Indiana. Local chapters run the activities.
who_can_apply: To join FFA, you must be enrolled in an agriculture course at your school. The page does not list grades or ages.
pay_detail: State dues are $14 per active member per year (includes national, state and district dues). Local chapters set their own local dues.
deadline_text: Indiana FFA says affiliation declarations are due October 1, rosters November 1 and student test numbers December 1. These are chapter deadlines for the teacher.
how_to_apply: Talk to your school counselor or agriculture teacher about enrolling in an agricultural education class. The Indiana Agricultural Education site explains how to start a program if your school has none.
notes: Not a job. Your school needs an ag class and an FFA chapter. The page links the Indiana Agricultural Education program for how to start one.
